newsitem.title: DENMARK: Unidanmark plunges after Capel downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Unidanmark plunges after Capel downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Danish banking group Unidanmark dived more than three percent on Wednesday, depressed by a 'sell' recommendation by British investment bank HSBC James Capel and a falling bond market, dealers said.
At 1230 GMT the share was down to 270 crowns compared to Tuesday's closing 280 crowns.

The James Capel report said that Unidanmark, Denmark's second-biggest bank, and top bank Den Danske Bank underperformed the market in 1996 and were likely to continue doing so. Den Danske fell less sharply, to 423 crowns from 432. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
